notes.title: The Long-Awaited 4k update is here!
notes.notes: Sometimes, even small changes make a big impact! This is why the game has been updated with 3k and 4k support. All you need to do is crank the resolution setting up to the max! Now even U:SC can make your gaming PC run hot, and not just grandma's laptop. (You can still run the game on grandma's laptop, tho. I like it when games can do that.)
